items.title: Approve the Minutes of the January 29, 2019 Meeting

Approve a 3 Year Professional Services Contracts, with Option to Extend, to Civic Edge Consulting and Convey, Inc. in a Combined Amount Not to Exceed $300,000 for On-Call Communications, Media and Community Relations
Adopt the 2018 Annual Report End of Consent Agenda
Approve the 2019 State and Federal Legislative Program
State and Federal Legislation Update – Support: Assembly Bill 252 (Daly) and Senate Bill 127 (Wiener)
Allocate $11,115,000 and Appropriate $500,000 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, for Six Requests
Adopt the Valencia Street Bikeway Implementation Plan Final Report [NTIP Planning]
Adopt the Fiscal Year 2019/20 Transportation Fund for Clean Air Local Expenditure Criteria

Execute Master Agreements and Any Amendments with CALTRANS for Receipt of Funds for Yerba Buena Island Westside Bridges Seismic Retrofit Project and the Yerba Buena Island Southgate Road Realignment Improvements Project

Award Two-Year Professional Services Contract, with Option to Extend, to Wiltec, Inc. in an Amount Not to Exceed $100,000 for Performance Monitoring and Analysis Services for the Congestion Management Program Other Items
